metadata.description: End-to-end tooling for resolving HL7 FHIR JIRA tickets across the FHIR core specification, the Extensions Pack, and FHIR Implementation Guides.

plugins.name: fhir-jira
plugins.description: Fetch a FHIR JIRA ticket, resolve its target repo, branch, edit the spec, run the IG Publisher, validate the QA delta, commit, push, open a PR, and watch CI. Batches that span multiple specs produce one PR per repo.
